profile_text.body:
Synopsys is a public company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, traded under the ticker SNPS and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000883241. On its own site the company describes itself as delivering silicon-to-systems solutions that help innovators accelerate development, reduce risk, and drive breakthroughs, and it presents its work across EDA tools, semiconductor IP, and systems verification. A recent item on the site covers Synopsys advancing power and performance for AI and multi-die designs on the latest Samsung Foundry processes at SAFE Forum 2026.

The site also carries a notice that visitors may interact with an AI-powered chatbot providing general information about Synopsys, its products, and its services, which the notice says may be incorrect or incomplete. The notice states that applicable agreements supersede anything the chatbot provides, that chats may be accessed by Synopsys and its service providers to customize the experience and improve the tool, and that using the chatbot constitutes agreement to that data processing.

The company's litigation exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 220. No individual cases, tracked products, or MCP servers are listed for it.
